title: File:South Downs Way in Queen Elizabeth Country Park - geograph.org.uk - 3941804.jpg
claims: The image shows a wide, light-coloured chalk and gravel path running straight through leafless woodland in Queen Elizabeth Country Park, with green verges and a blue sky.

The file title identifies the South Downs Way in Queen Elizabeth Country Park; it contains no SDW100, Centurion Running or race-day context and is a location photograph, not the QECP aid station, crew field or race markings.
The author is Dave Kelly; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 2.0; the original is 4,320 x 3,240 pixels (about 5.53 MB), dated 10 April 2014, and the Commons file page carries Geograph image 3941804.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 Commons thumbnail of 334,177 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source; attribution and share-alike are required.
